[[File:Crado_robe_render.png|thumb|250px|Crado's robe.]]
These '''[[Jedi apparel/Legends|robes]]''' were believed to have belonged to the fallen [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Crado]], who fell under the sway of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. Since Crado was vaporized by the explosion of the [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]], it was unlikely that they actually belonged to him; however they were nonetheless a powerful, if tainted, item, bestowing greatly increased strength to the wearer.

It was possible that the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] acquired these robes during her travels in [[3951 BBY]], in the midst of the [[First Jedi Purge]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the game, only a character whose alignment is [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-sided]] can equip this item.
